name: generation_change_reset
comment: generation-change reset: the producer explicitly declares SwmrReset (e.g. datascad's query generation changed -- opaque to taut-shape, carried in `detail`) while a reader is held caught-up at epoch=0/head=0 (PH0-D20); reset increments the node epoch to 1 and answers immediately with state=reset, reset_reason=producer_requested, reset_detail=gen2, no snapshot/deltas, next_cursor ABSENT (no snapshot survives a reset -- PH0-D19) -- a typed announcement, not silence. A subsequent probe read (cursor absent, timeout_ms=0) then sees would_block until the producer pushes a fresh snapshot.
